title: Math-LLaVA: Bootstrapping Mathematical Reasoning for Multimodal Large Language Models
authors_zh: Wenhao Shi, Zhiqiang Hu, Yi Bin, Junhua Liu, Yang Yang, See-Kiong Ng, Lidong Bing, Roy Ka-Wei Lee
paper_type_zh: 多模态数学指令数据构造研究
best_for_zh: 适合构建图像推理 SFT 数据，或审计教师生成短答案示范的读者。
one_line: Math-LLaVA turns 40k selected images into an open 360k-record multimodal mathematics instruction set and measures the contribution of selection and four synthesis operations.
Math-LLaVA 将四万张筛选图像扩展为开放的三十六万条多模态数学问答，并用消融实验区分图像选择与四类合成操作的贡献。
why: It exposes a compact, inspectable recipe for increasing questions per image and provides ablations that distinguish selection from synthetic record expansion.
inclusion_reason: Math-LLaVA centrally constructs and openly releases serialized multimodal question-answer demonstrations, then isolates how selection and four synthesis operations affect an SFT consumer.

title: Problem
问题
html:
# Problem

Open multimodal instruction sets commonly attach only one or a few questions to each image, leaving much of the visual evidence unused and giving SFT consumers weak coverage of mathematical question forms. Math-LLaVA selects 40k images from 24 public sources, then expands them into about 360k image-question-answer records.

The decision boundary is data selection and synthetic demonstration construction, not a new reasoning objective: learned clarity and complexity classifiers choose images, GPT-4V writes additional or rewritten questions and short answers, and LLaVA-1.5-13B consumes the released records through SFT.

L4 facts: official source ACL Anthology 2024.findings-emnlp.268; Findings of EMNLP 2024; Track 01 object is an image path plus user prompt and assistant answer; collection state L4_carded with one controlled category.

# 问题

开放多模态指令集通常只给每张图像配一两个问题，图中大量信息没有进入监督记录，SFT 模型接触到的数学问法也不够丰富。Math-LLaVA 从二十四个公开来源筛出四万张图像，再扩展为约三十六万条图像、问题与答案记录。

论文的判断边界是数据选择与合成示范构造，而不是新的推理目标：清晰度和复杂度分类器负责选图，GPT-4V 生成新增或改写的问答，LLaVA-1.5-13B 通过 SFT 消费公开记录。

L4 事实：官方来源为 ACL Anthology 2024.findings-emnlp.268；正式发表于 Findings of EMNLP 2024；Track 01 对象是图像路径、用户问题和助手答案；收录状态为 L4_carded，仅使用一个受控分类。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
# Core idea

Math-LLaVA first converts heterogeneous public image-QA sources into a clarity- and complexity-controlled 40k seed pool, then increases questions per image through task-conditioned generation, harder variants, paraphrases, and underspecified variants. The serialized target is an image-linked LLaVA conversation; GPT-4V is the synthetic trace author, source answers and prompt-format constraints provide the selection signal, and LLaVA-1.5 SFT is the consumer, which makes the public demonstration records a Track 01 object rather than a model-only contribution.

Google Scholar citations: 239（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=Math-LLaVA%3A+Bootstrapping+Mathematical+Reasoning+for+Multimodal+Large+Language+Models&author=Wenhao+Shi&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes Dataset name: MathV360K Official URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Zhiqiang007/MathV360K Scale: about 40k images and 360k question-answer records; the annotation JSON is 174.6 MB Record form: id, image path, and a conversations list containing human image-grounded prompts and GPT short answers File / storage format: one public JSON annotation file plus source-organized image directories Domains / languages: algebra, arithmetic, geometry, logic, numerical reasoning, science, textbook QA, charts, documents, and general VQA; mostly English with a Chinese GeoQA+ subset Construction and filtering: GPT-4V labels 10k images; two ViT classifiers filter and stratify all sources; GPT-4V adds 200k new questions and 120k complex, rephrased, or underspecified variants License / access constraints: public; code is Apache-2.0, while records and images inherit mixed Apache, MIT, BSD, GPL, Creative Commons, and research-only source terms Intended use: multimodal SFT, distillation, data-mixture ablation, and audits of questions-per-image synthesis

# 核心思想

Math-LLaVA 先把异构公开图像问答源压缩成受清晰度与复杂度控制的四万条种子池，再通过按任务生成新问题、增加难度、同义改写和欠明确改写来提高每张图像的问题密度。序列化目标是关联图像的 LLaVA 对话，GPT-4V 是合成记录作者，源答案与格式约束提供筛选信号，LLaVA-1.5 的 SFT 是消费端，因此中心贡献属于公开示范数据，而非只发布模型。

Google Scholar 引用数：239（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=Math-LLaVA%3A+Bootstrapping+Mathematical+Reasoning+for+Multimodal+Large+Language+Models&author=Wenhao+Shi&hl=en）

开放数据集：是 数据集名称：MathV360K 官方地址：https://huggingface.co/datasets/Zhiqiang007/MathV360K 规模：约四万张图像、三十六万条问答；标注 JSON 文件为 174.6 MB 记录形式：id、图像路径，以及含有人类图像问题和助手短答案的 conversations 列表 文件/存储格式：一个公开 JSON 标注文件，加按来源组织的图像目录 领域/语言：覆盖代数、算术、几何、逻辑、数值推理、科学、教材问答、图表、文档和通用视觉问答；以英文为主，GeoQA+ 子集含中文 构造与过滤：GPT-4V 标注一万张图像，两个 ViT 分类器筛选并分层全部来源；GPT-4V 再增加二十万条新问题和十二万条高难、改写或欠明确变体 许可/访问约束：公开访问；代码采用 Apache-2.0，记录与图像继承 Apache、MIT、BSD、GPL、Creative Commons 和仅限研究等混合上游条款 预期用途：多模态 SFT、蒸馏、数据混合消融，以及每图多问合成审计

title: Method
方法
html:
# Method

  1. Select a seed pool. Input: image-question-answer triples from 24 public datasets. Process: GPT-4V labels 10k sampled images for clarity and comprehension complexity, and two ViT classifiers propagate those labels. Output: clear candidates with complexity scores. Check / stop rule: discard predicted-unclear images and select 40k records at a 2:3:4:1 complexity ratio across sources.
  2. Mine new questions from each image. Input: a selected image, its seed question, and five task families. Process: cluster source questions with TF-IDF and K-Means, sample task-specific demonstrations, and ask GPT-4V for up to five nonduplicate definite-answer questions. Output: 200k new image-question-answer records. Check / stop rule: prompts forbid uncertain questions, duplicated seed content, and answers longer than the requested short form; there is no independent correctness checker.
  3. Transform the seed question. Input: each of the 40k original questions and its image. Process: GPT-4V separately creates a harder multi-step version, a semantically equivalent rephrasing, and a shorter underspecified version answerable with the image. Output: 120k additional records, producing MathV360K when combined with seeds and mined questions. Check / stop rule: preserve the seed answer for rephrased and underspecified variants, while prompt compliance is the reported acceptance boundary.
  4. Train and evaluate the consumer. Input: MathV360K and LLaVA-1.5-13B. Process: fine-tune the language model and projection layer for two epochs at learning rate 2e-5 and batch size 16. Output: Math-LLaVA and results on MathVista, Math-V, MathVerse, and MMMU. Check / stop rule: benchmark answer accuracy measures the final consumer; ablations hold the base architecture fixed while changing selected and synthesized data components.

Reproducibility: verify the ACL paper, the 174.6 MB public annotation JSON, image acquisition instructions, Apache-2.0 training code, source-license table, ViT labeling prompts, and GPT-4V synthesis prompts. A faithful rebuild must also freeze GPT-4V and ViT revisions, cluster seeds, the source snapshot, and image-level splits; temperature, retry policy, random seeds, API cost, and a synthetic-answer error rate are not disclosed.

# 方法

  1. 选择种子池。输入是二十四个公开数据集的图像、问题和答案三元组。处理过程先让 GPT-4V 给随机抽取的一万张图像标注清晰度与理解复杂度，再用两个 ViT 分类器推广标签。输出是带复杂度分数的清晰候选。检查/停止规则是丢弃预测为模糊的图像，并按 2:3:4:1 的复杂度比例跨来源选出四万条记录。
  2. 从每张图像挖掘新问题。输入是一张入选图像、种子问题和五类任务。处理过程用 TF-IDF 与 K-Means 聚类源问题，抽取任务专属示例，再让 GPT-4V 最多生成五个不重复且有确定答案的问题。输出是二十万条新图像问答。检查/停止规则通过提示禁止不确定问题、重复种子内容和超出短答案格式的输出，但没有独立正确性检查器。
  3. 变换种子问题。输入是每个原问题及其图像。GPT-4V 分别生成需要更多步骤的难题、语义等价改写和依赖图像才能理解的简短欠明确版本。输出是十二万条附加记录，与种子和新问题合并成 MathV360K。检查/停止规则要求改写与欠明确版本保留原答案，而论文报告的验收边界主要是提示遵循。
  4. 训练并评估消费模型。输入是 MathV360K 与 LLaVA-1.5-13B。处理过程以 2e-5 学习率、批量十六训练两个周期，并更新语言模型与投影层。输出是 Math-LLaVA 及其在 MathVista、Math-V、MathVerse 和 MMMU 上的结果。检查/停止规则由基准答案准确率决定；消融保持基础架构不变，只改变筛选和合成数据组件。

复现要点：应核验 ACL 论文、174.6 MB 的公开标注 JSON、图像获取说明、Apache-2.0 训练代码、源许可表、ViT 标注提示和 GPT-4V 合成提示。严格复现还需固定 GPT-4V 与 ViT 版本、聚类随机性、源数据快照和图像级切分；论文没有披露温度、重试策略、随机种子、接口成本及合成答案错误率。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
# Evidence

Claim: selection plus four augmentation operations, rather than model architecture alone, improve the MathVista consumer. Controlled setup: Table 5 always fine-tunes LLaVA-1.5-13B and changes only the 40k sampling/selection choice and which MathV360K augmentation components are included. Result: random 40k sampling scores 35.6, learned selection scores 38.2, selection plus image-mined QA scores 42.2, and the full mixture reaches 46.6 accuracy; Table 1 places the reproduced base at 27.7. Boundary: the comparison supports this mixture on MathVista, but synthetic-answer correctness is not independently measured and the full mixture also increases record count, so it does not isolate quality from scale.

# 证据

主张：图像选择与四类扩增操作共同改善 MathVista 消费模型，而不是架构变化带来结果。受控配置：表 5 始终微调 LLaVA-1.5-13B，只改变四万条数据的随机/学习筛选方式及纳入哪些 MathV360K 扩增组件。结果：随机抽样得 35.6，学习筛选得 38.2，筛选加每图新问答得 42.2，完整混合达到 46.6；表 1 的复现基础模型为 27.7。边界：结果支持该混合在 MathVista 上有效，但论文没有独立测量合成答案正确率，完整混合也增加了记录数，因此不能把质量收益与规模收益完全分开。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
# Novelty

Earlier visual instruction sets usually reuse each image with few questions, so the image rather than the question inventory limits supervision. Math-LLaVA changes the auditable data decision by first stratifying images for clarity and complexity and then applying four named question-expansion operations to the same seed pool. Its component ablation makes selection, image mining, difficulty, paraphrase consistency, and underspecification separately inspectable. LLaVA fine-tuning, GPT-4V synthesis, and image-QA aggregation are not individually new.

# 新意

以往视觉指令集通常只复用每张图像的一两个问题，监督覆盖受问题清单而非图像数量限制。Math-LLaVA 改变的可审计决策，是先按清晰度与复杂度分层图像，再对同一种子池执行四种命名明确的问题扩展操作。组件消融使筛选、图像挖掘、难度、同义一致性与欠明确改写可以分别检查。LLaVA 微调、GPT-4V 合成和图像问答汇总本身都不是新方法。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
# Limitations

  • Author-stated boundary: released records contain images, questions, and short answers but no intermediate rationales; do not treat them as process supervision or use answer form as evidence of faithful reasoning.
  • Curator audit risk: GPT-4V creates synthetic questions and answers without an independent verifier; sample image-answer consistency by operation type and report error rates before reuse.
  • Curator audit risk: records inherit mixed source licenses and share images across many variants; resolve per-source redistribution terms and enforce image-level deduplication and splits.

# 局限

  • 作者明确的边界：公开记录只有图像、问题和短答案，没有中间推理；不能把它当作过程监督，也不能用答案格式证明推理忠实。
  • 策展审计风险：GPT-4V 同时生成合成问题与答案，却没有独立验证器；复用前应按操作类型抽查图像与答案一致性并报告错误率。
  • 策展审计风险：记录继承混合源许可，同一图像又对应多个变体；发布或商用前需逐源确认再分发条款，并实施图像级去重与切分。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
# Usefulness

  • Multimodal data builder: start from image-QA seeds, reproduce clarity and complexity stratification, and generate task-conditioned question variants; output LLaVA conversation JSON and keep operation provenance for every record.
  • Dataset auditor: group the public records by source image and synthesis operation, then measure answer error, effective image diversity, near duplicates, and license coverage rather than only model accuracy.
  • Do not use when: the application requires step-by-step rationales, independently verified answers, or a single permissive dataset license; MathV360K does not provide those guarantees.

# 用处

  • 多模态数据构建者：从图像问答种子出发，复现清晰度和复杂度分层，再生成按任务条件化的问题变体；输出 LLaVA 对话 JSON，并为每条记录保留操作来源。
  • 数据审计者：按源图像和合成操作分组公开记录，测量答案错误、有效图像多样性、近重复和许可覆盖，而不是只看模型准确率。
  • 不适用情形：任务要求分步推理、独立核验答案或单一宽松数据许可时不应直接采用；MathV360K 不提供这些保证。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
# Reading notes

  • Positioning: the paper addresses low question density per image, not a new multimodal architecture.
  • Method handle: 40k selected seeds become 360k records through image mining plus complex, rephrased, and underspecified variants.
  • Data handle: the public 174.6 MB JSON serializes an image path and two-turn LLaVA conversation; it does not serialize a rationale.
  • Evidence anchor: under the same LLaVA-1.5-13B consumer, random 40k sampling scores 35.6 on MathVista, selection 38.2, and the full mixture 46.6.
  • Reuse decision: use for short-answer multimodal SFT only after operation-stratified answer audits, image-level split checks, and per-source license review.

# 阅读笔记

  • 定位：论文解决的是每张图像问题密度低，而不是提出新的多模态架构。
  • 方法抓手：四万条筛选种子经图像挖掘、高难、同义和欠明确变体扩展为三十六万条记录。
  • 数据抓手：公开的 174.6 MB JSON 序列化图像路径与两轮 LLaVA 对话，不包含推理过程。
  • 证据锚点：同一 LLaVA-1.5-13B 消费模型在 MathVista 上，随机四万条得 35.6，学习筛选得 38.2，完整混合得 46.6。
  • 复用判断：只在按操作审计答案、检查图像级切分并逐源复核许可后，用于短答案多模态 SFT。
